item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 03/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. Winds will be weak over the region and the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Monday. It will be windier with a few showers over the region in the following couple of days.
